record.field: Prepares and serves orders within the target times, even at rush hours.
Applies hygiene rules, HACCP practices, storage temperatures and keeps the station clean.
Welcomes guests, handles requests and complaints politely and efficiently.
Comes on time to every shift and respects breaks and schedules.
Helps colleagues, communicates clearly between kitchen and floor.
Wears the full uniform, follows company policies and the work regulations.
